title: Decoding the Underlying Meaning of Multimodal Hateful Memes
measurement_description: The paper evaluated the ability of text-only and vision-language pre-trained models (PLMs) to automatically generate underlying contextual reasons for multimodal hateful memes. This included measuring whether models could accurately identify and explain memes targeting specific religious groups (e.g., Jews, Muslims) or if they hallucinated religious targets and misinformation.
findings: The models struggled with accurately identifying the specific social targets of hateful memes and sometimes hallucinated religious targets. For example, the text-only T5 model incorrectly generated an explanation vilifying 'Muslims' as terrorists when presented with a meme whose ground truth actually targeted white people, highlighting the model's failure to capture accurate visual demographic information.
